root_cause.text: The ublk control path’s `UBLK_CMD_UPDATE_SIZE` handler calls `ublk_ctrl_set_size()` without validating that `ub->ub_disk` has been created and is non-NULL, so `set_capacity_and_notify()` can dereference a NULL disk pointer before `START_DEV` or after `STOP_DEV`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch comment states `ub->ub_disk is NULL before UBLK_CMD_START_DEV completes ... and after UBLK_CMD_STOP_DEV runs`, and the diff shows `ublk_ctrl_set_size()` previously did `set_capacity_and_notify(ub->ub_disk, p->dev_sectors);` unconditionally; the fix adds `if (!ub->ub_disk) { ret = -ENODEV; goto out; }` under `ub->mutex` and changes the caller to return that error.

agent_logs.root_cause_candidate: The ublk control path’s `UBLK_CMD_UPDATE_SIZE` handler calls `ublk_ctrl_set_size()` without validating that `ub->ub_disk` has been created and is non-NULL, so `set_capacity_and_notify()` can dereference a NULL disk pointer before `START_DEV` or after `STOP_DEV`.
agent_logs.evidence_points: The patch comment states `ub->ub_disk is NULL before UBLK_CMD_START_DEV completes ... and after UBLK_CMD_STOP_DEV runs`, and the diff shows `ublk_ctrl_set_size()` previously did `set_capacity_and_notify(ub->ub_disk, p->dev_sectors);` unconditionally; the fix adds `if (!ub->ub_disk) { ret = -ENODEV; goto out; }` under `ub->mutex` and changes the caller to return that error.

intent_record.intent_summary: Return an error from ublk size updates when the device disk is unavailable instead of assuming it exists.
intent_record.what: The function `ublk_ctrl_set_size()` was changed from returning `void` to returning `int`. A local `ret` variable was added, and the function now checks `if (!ub->ub_disk)` after taking `ub->mutex`; if the disk is absent, it sets `ret = -ENODEV`, skips the size update, unlocks the mutex, and returns the error. On the normal path it still updates `p->dev_sectors` and calls `set_capacity_and_notify()`, then returns 0.
intent_record.how: At runtime, the size-setting control path now fails cleanly when the backing disk object has not been created or is no longer available, instead of dereferencing `ub->ub_disk` unconditionally. This prevents an invalid operation on a missing device and provides the caller with an explicit `-ENODEV` error.

intent_record.intent_summary: Propagate the return value of ublk_ctrl_set_size() so update-size failures are reported correctly.
intent_record.what: In the UBLK_CMD_UPDATE_SIZE case, the code no longer calls ublk_ctrl_set_size() as a standalone statement followed by ret = 0; instead it assigns the return value of ublk_ctrl_set_size(ub, &header) directly to ret.
intent_record.how: The update-size command now propagates the actual success or failure status from ublk_ctrl_set_size() back to the caller instead of always reporting success, allowing errors during size updates to be detected and handled.

grouping_result.intent: Return an error from ublk size updates when the device disk is unavailable instead of assuming it exists.
Propagate the return value of ublk_ctrl_set_size() so update-size failures are reported correctly.

relevance_review.reason: The change directly matches the root cause: it adds validation/error handling for ublk size updates when the disk is unavailable, preventing the NULL disk dereference in the UPDATE_SIZE path before START_DEV or after STOP_DEV.

The change only propagates the return value from ublk_ctrl_set_size() to report failures. It does not add the missing NULL check for ub->ub_disk or prevent set_capacity_and_notify() from dereferencing a NULL disk before START_DEV or after STOP_DEV.

candidates.rationale: This statement dereferences ub->ub_disk during size updates without first verifying the disk pointer is non-NULL. If UPDATE_SIZE is issued before START_DEV or after STOP_DEV, ub->ub_disk can be NULL and this call can trigger a NULL pointer dereference.

vuln_statements.explanation: This size-update path dereferences ub->ub_disk directly without checking that the disk has been created. If UBLK_CMD_UPDATE_SIZE is handled before START_DEV or after STOP_DEV, ub->ub_disk may be NULL and this call can trigger a NULL pointer dereference.

commit 98b995660bff011d8e00af03abd74ac7d1ac1390
Author: Omri Mann <omri@nvidia.com>
Date:   Mon Apr 21 13:59:50 2025 +0300

    ublk: Add UBLK_U_CMD_UPDATE_SIZE
    
    Currently ublk only allows the size of the ublkb block device to be
    set via UBLK_CMD_SET_PARAMS before UBLK_CMD_START_DEV is triggered.
    
    This does not provide support for extendable user-space block devices
    without having to stop and restart the underlying ublkb block device
    causing IO interruption.
bic_trace_step.reason: The snippet shows the new handler directly calling the resize helper without any NULL check on the disk: `case UBLK_CMD_UPDATE_SIZE: ublk_ctrl_set_size(ub, header); ret = 0; break;`. The helper itself unconditionally does `set_capacity_and_notify(ub->ub_disk, p->dev_sectors);` after only taking `ub->mutex`, with no validation that `ub->ub_disk` is non-NULL. This matches the root cause because `UPDATE_SIZE` can be issued before `START_DEV` or after `STOP_DEV`, when `ub->ub_disk` may not exist, so the vulnerable construct is present and no fix is shown here.
